name: Demon Waltz
storyline:
The world of demon waltz is being erased.

Naturally, you oppose that kind of thing, and are compelled to save it.

With your allies you will, with any luck, save the world and discover the intentions of its villain in this short rpg about making things, growing up, and candycorn.
